svg.title: The Rust Express
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon map of the finished line. One Rust track runs from Your app straight through seven orange stations built over the track (Gate, Router, Cache, Vault, Customs, Post office, Ledger), then splits into four Rust lines to the providers. Trains roll through without stopping. One small wooden hut, labeled your own Python callback, still sits off the track up a little road, with crates waiting to be repacked.
svg.text: Track the whole way and Rust at every stop: the trip the test track was measuring.
